title: DECISION: STARTTLS removes itself from CAPABILITIES after upgrade
description: starttls_integration tests verify: STARTTLS is not in CAPABILITIES after successful upgrade; a second STARTTLS returns 502 not 382. Per RFC 4642 a server advertising STARTTLS on an already-TLS session would confuse clients into a second upgrade attempt. The test checks both the absence of the capability and the 502 response code. A future contributor might omit the post-upgrade capability check as cosmetic, which would violate RFC 4642 section 2.2.
